scope: Independent review of numerical exhibit and honest benchmark wording. No model or PDF edits; no new channel research.

recommended_exhibit.headline: Better durability can close the valuation gap.
recommended_exhibit.subhead: Sequential sensitivity of December 31, 2026 conditional value; USD per share.

steps.label: Central economics and risk
steps.conditions: 35% mature DCAI operating margin; 0.80 incremental sales / net capital; 11.555% operating discount rate.

steps.label: Same operations, declining risk
steps.conditions: 11.555% through 2030, then falls 0.15 percentage point annually to 10.055% in 2040.

steps.label: Stronger margins AND capital efficiency
steps.conditions: 40% mature DCAI operating margin AND 1.00 incremental sales / net capital, under the same declining-risk curve.

recommended_exhibit.presentation: Three value columns with incremental arrows, plus horizontal $58.28 reference line. Label rate change and joint operating change separately. Small callout: favorable case exceeds the quote without adding a new external wafer program.
limits: Scenario sensitivity, not separate independent alpha sources.
Operating increment jointly changes margins and capital efficiency; do not label it pure margin impact.
Sequential attribution depends on path because operations and discount rates interact.
Values use forecast Dec.31 cash; quote is 57 days earlier. Neither $46.96 nor $60.90 is a 3-5 year exit target.
Central 2030 conditional value is $70.97777531, so current valuation gap is not a passive short profit forecast.

benchmark_panel.headline: The forecast already allows a strong earnings recovery.
source_locators: Cash conversion paragraph and valuation text: 2027 FCF negative, capex 30B/32B
benchmark_panel.required_footnote: One analyst, not consensus. My EPS is an adjusted proxy using 5.51B planning claims; tax, share and adjustment conventions are not fully matched.
benchmark_panel.interpretation: This is evidence that the short does not rely on weak headline earnings. It is not a measured consensus miss. Negative 2027 free cash flow and large capital spending are already public concerns.
exclude: Do not compare Products-only revenue with iFAST consolidated revenue.
Do not reuse iFAST $70.87 reference or SELL label as confirmation at our $58.28 quote.
Do not equate our economic owner cash to reported adjusted FCF.
Do not attribute the entire EPS difference to CPU mix.

honest_thesis_forecast_chain.evidence: Intel Q3 2026 reports premium mix driving most of 54% server ASP growth; 2025 ASP fell 4% on pricing and mix.
honest_thesis_forecast_chain.judgment: Credit recovery, then normalize price/mix gains.
honest_thesis_forecast_chain.boundary: Timing and exact path are author assumptions; current profit strength and persistent shortages support the opposing case.

honest_thesis_forecast_chain.evidence: Tools, substrates and packaging remain necessary; Intel Ireland expansion uses existing cleanrooms but adds tools and upgrades.
honest_thesis_forecast_chain.judgment: Existing buildings do not eliminate the funding requirement.
honest_thesis_forecast_chain.forecast: 2027-2030 operating profit $111.25B; net operating investment $70.27B; economic owner cash $27.59B.
honest_thesis_forecast_chain.boundary: These cumulative forecast quantities are not measured market expectations or incremental ROIC.

honest_thesis_forecast_chain.evidence: DCF can be recalculated under matched operations and risk alternatives.
honest_thesis_forecast_chain.judgment: Require compensation for durability and manufacturing risk.
honest_thesis_forecast_chain.forecast: $46.96 central; $53.77 declining risk; $60.90 stronger economics plus declining risk.
honest_thesis_forecast_chain.boundary: This is one linked conditional valuation argument, with modest position economics, not two proven independent edges.

gaps_fillable_now: Clear recommendation and dated value dashboard, with current valuation vs horizon cover separated.
Explicit evidence -> judgment -> forecast mapping, with observed and forecast inputs labeled.
Sequential value sensitivity bridge quantifying the strongest opposing case.
Named public-estimate benchmark with visible accounting limitations.
Compact what-changes-the-view matrix using existing 2027/2028 output, profit, investment and cash thresholds.
gaps_not_fillable_by_rewording: Original expert or customer interviews and representative channel evidence have not been conducted.
No fully matched consensus cash-flow/mature-margin/capital-expenditure dataset establishing an overlooked operating forecast gap.
No demonstrated dated catalyst for repricing; operating checkpoints are not automatic price catalysts.
No robust expected relative-return advantage across reasonable matched-method alternatives; scenario arithmetic does not estimate probabilities.
bottom_line: A more recognizable competition-deck structure can improve communication. It cannot honestly manufacture the operating evidence or measured expectations gap found in stronger research examples.
